description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class ShopProductRelationshipTag used to display related products within a web application. It interacts with services to fetch product relationships and populates cache for performance optimization.

classes.name: ShopProductRelationshipTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class for rendering related product groups, integrating with services and cache layers to fetch and display related products based on group name.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Main logic executed at the start of the custom tag, initializes services if needed, constructs cache keys, retrieves products from cache or fetches live data, and sets request attributes.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the custom tag processing, indicating to evaluate the rest of the page.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches related products for the given store and group by querying the ProductRelationshipService, then converts them into ReadableProduct instances.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the group name used for retrieving product relationships.

methods.name: setGroupName
methods.description: Sets the group name for product relationship retrieval.
